public_rationale: The sentence gives the speaker's opinion: because OpenAI would not define 'weekly active user', he says nothing but number-gaming can be assumed. He labels this 'in my opinion', and later in the post he says it 'isn't obvious' whether OpenAI is honest about the figure. So he is stating a suspicion and a view on what can be inferred, not a proven fact that OpenAI manipulated its numbers. Grading it as a factual charge of manipulation would be unfair to him. The one factual element, OpenAI's reply to his own request, rests only on his own account. There is no true-or-false outcome to assign.
limitations: If one chose to test only whether OpenAI publicly defined WAU in February 2025, the result would rest on a reading of 'refuses' that the speaker did not spell out.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Not adjudicable. Evidence that OpenAI's numbers were not gamed would not falsify an opinion about what can be assumed without a definition.
